/: Weld Engineering Co. makes submerged arc flux handling equipment: flux recovery systems, pressure feed tanks, auto-mixing units and flux ovens. Since 1979.
/new: New from Weld Engineering: the MV-5 flux vacuum, FTV-3000 automatic transfer valve, DC-30 dust collector, PS-7500 and SPS-7500 systems, and 850°F rebake ovens.
/sd: Standard duty submerged arc flux recovery: Mighty-Might AS-4, AP-1, PS-2 and ALT-2, XP-3 and XP-4T air-powered units, and the DC-30 dust collector.
/hd: Heavy duty submerged arc flux recovery: MV-5 vacuum, Mighty-Mac 1500X to 7500X, pipe mill systems, and SPS and PS systems from 2 to 7.5 HP.
/pf: Submerged arc flux pressure feed and recovery: PFR-3 and LPFR-3 systems, PT and heated HPT feed tanks from 60 to 2000 lb, PFR-3000 series and FTV-3000 valve.
/ham: Heated automatic flux mixing systems that blend new and recovered flux at a preset ratio: HAMX-50, GHAMX-150 and HPFR-HAMX-3000 pressure feed models.
/ro: Flux re-bake and holding ovens: HTS-700-850 and HTP-100-850 super ovens up to 850°F, plus FO-700HT and PFO-100 ovens with automatic re-bake cycles.
/tb: Typical submerged arc flux recovery system configurations with Weld Engineering part numbers, descriptions and downloadable PDF drawings for each setup.
/calc: Estimate what flux recovery saves: enter weld metal per week, flux cost, labor rate and equipment cost to get a cost reduction estimate.
/mission: About Weld Engineering Co., Inc. of Shrewsbury, MA: our values and mission as a manufacturer of submerged arc flux handling systems since 1979.
